public_note: This Noether Paper 29 RA71 package is a narrow source-header and footnote-counter repair candidate, not a whole Paper 29 certification.

files.quality_label: Noether Paper 29 RA71 German source-header/footnote-counter repair candidate
files.coverage: Paper 29, Der Endlichkeitssatz der Invarianten endlicher linearer Gruppen der Charakteristik p, Nachr. v. d. Ges. d. Wiss. zu Goettingen 1926, printed pp.28-35. The package contains a German cumulative TeX/PDF/log candidate, RA70-to-RA71 diff, GDZ IIIF source manifest and raw full-page JPGs for printed pp.28-35, assembled source PDF, labelled 1200dpi inspection crops, fix/disposition/source-crop CSVs, method note, README, and checksums.
files.findings: The source opening has `Von Emmy Noether in Goettingen.` before the Courant submission line, and source footnotes on printed p.28 begin at `1)`, `2)`, `3)`. RA70 omitted the author line and lacked a Paper 29 footnote-counter reset after Paper 25. RA71 restores the centered source author line, keeps the Courant submission line in the header block, and inserts `\setcounter{footnote}{0}` before the Paper 29 notes. No body prose or mathematics changed. XeLaTeX compiled successfully twice; the package notes only the standard inputenc warning under a UTF-8 engine.
files.limitations: Targeted source-apparatus/header repair evidence only. It does not certify every Paper 29 formula or prose line, does not promote a unified German branch, and does not propagate to English, Spanish, Japanese, French, Chinese, Ukrainian, Russian, or Interslavic branches.
